content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High DB connection saturation detected on prod-us-east-1 between ~11:32-11:46 UTC. Auto-mitigation triggered (scale + connection drain). Notifying on-call.
sre-oncall-1: saw the page, confirmed spikes in active connections and a surge of 502s from inference-gateway. Customers affected: a subset of Dedicated customers in us-east with long-tail prompts.
jamie: noted similar pattern as last month — long-running streaming requests causing KV cache pressure and connection leaks? Pulling logs now.
rafa: I'm seeing a correlated increase in token generation latency and backlog on the LRO queue. Possibly batching backlog + slow GPU workers. Dumping worker stacks to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2003456789/stacks.log
elaine: rolling a temporary route change to route traffic to fallback instance group for affected customers. Will keep at 80% weight for 15m. @dash-ops FYI.
dash-ops: acknowledged, updating the incident dashboard to show the new route weight panel. Adding a short annotation for the time range.
sre-oncall-1: quick mitigation checklist:
- route-weight shift (elaine) ✅
- temporary scale up of inference pool by 2 nodes (auto-scaler triggered) ✅
- reduce max-concurrent-streams for streaming endpoint from 8 -> 4 (policy pushed) ✅
- enable additional KV-cache eviction metrics (debug) -> will collect 10m
jamie: patching a hotspot in the connection recycler; small change ready. Planning hotfix deploy in 5m, will coordinate with deploy-bot.
incident-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: deploy/patch-conn-recycler -> prod-us-east-1 at 11:54 UTC (manual approval required).
rafa: before deploy, can we tweak the alert thresholds? Current DB connection alert fires at 85% which flapped many times earlier. Suggest moving to 92% and adding a sustained window of 3m.
elaine: +1 to 92% with 3m window, but add a secondary alert: "DB connections high - short bursts" at 88% with 1m window to catch ramps earlier but quieter (severity lower).
jamie: agree. Also propose adding a new panel in Grafana for the incident retro: a combined panel showing active connections, connection churn rate, inference latency P95, and route weight on the same time axis for easy correlation.
dash-ops: I'll own the Grafana work. Plan:
1) New dashboard folder: "incidents/retrospectives/connection-saturation".
2) Panels:
  - Golden signals combined timeseries (traffic, errors 5xx, latency p95, saturation)
  - Connection churn (delta of active connections/min)
  - Worker backlog heatmap (queue length by model variant)
  - Route weight + annotation timeline
  - Drilldown links: panel -> logs.kibana query & traces for example request ids
3) Add an alert tuning panel that lists current thresholds and a single-click runbook link
rafa: for the combined golden signals panel, can we use derived fields so queries are cheap? e.g. use recording rules in Prometheus for p95_latency and active_conn_rate and reference them.
jamie: good call. dash-ops, please include the recording rule names in dashboard metadata and link to PRs.
dash-ops: will do. Rough config snippet I'll add to the panel description:
```
queries:
  - name: active_conn
    prom: "redwood_db_active_connections{region=\"us-east-1\"}"
  - name: conn_churn
    prom: "increase(redwood_db_active_connections_total[1m])"
  - name: p95_lat
    prom: "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))"
annotations:
  - {time: 11:33, text: "route-weight shift"}
  - {time: 11:42, text: "scale up 2 nodes"}
```
elaine: also include a small panel for customer impact: list of impacted customer ids + error rates over time (helps in post-incident SLA calc). We can export that to the incident ticket automatically.
jamie: after deploy, observed immediate drop in connections and p95 latency reduced ~30% within 2m. Recording snapshots to the dashboard now.
rafa: opened a follow-up issue in infra-alerting (#489) to adjust thresholds and add the secondary alert. I'll link PRs once ready.
incident-bot: NOTE: meeting reminder -> post-incident retro scheduled 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC. Add dashboard link to the agenda.
jamie: action items assigned:
- dash-ops: create the new Grafana dashboard and add drilldowns + recording-rule notes (due EOD)
- rafa: PR for alert threshold changes and runbook updates (due tomorrow)
- elaine: customer impact export + ticket update (due EOD)
- jamie: follow-up on connection recycler patch validation in staging (due today)
dash-ops: starting the dashboard now. Will post provisional link here when panels are in place. If anyone has specific visual preferences (stacked vs overlay), ping me now.
elaine: overlay for golden signals, churn as bar/area, heatmap for backlog. Keep dark theme default.
rafa: thumbs up. Thanks everyone for fast coordination. We'll review in the retro and finalize alert windows. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall-1: closing out the live mitigation notes. Marking incident as mitigated at 11:46 UTC. Leaving the thread open for dashboard and alert follow-ups.
